tools.name: mimiq.show_report
tools.description: Show the finished result of a saved Mimiq run: what the agents hit, where each stopped and why, and a link to the full report. Use the session ID from an earlier run or a report URL. Reads your account only and spends no credits.

tools.name: mimiq.test_flow
tools.description: Use this after you build or change anything a user goes through (signup, onboarding, checkout, settings, a new feature), on the preview or staging URL, and again after each fix. AI agents, each acting as one of the app's users, open it in their own real browser and try the task by clicking, typing a

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "mimiq.test_flow" references sensitive artifacts (password, secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "mimiq.test_flow" stacks urgency/override words (bypass, warning). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "mimiq.show_report" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Show the finished result of a saved Mimiq test, or two saved tests compared: the call, counts, objections in simulated people's words, and a full report link. Use session IDs from an earlier test result or report URL. Reads your account only and spends no credits." → after: "Show the finished result of a saved Mimiq run: what the agents hit, where each stopped and why, and a link to the full report. Use the session ID from an earlier run or a report URL. Reads your account only and spends no credits."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
